name: DIPHENHYDRAMINE 25 MG 30 CAPSULES
description: Diphenhydramine 25 mg is an antihistamine medication used to treat allergy symptoms and occasional insomnia. It is important to always consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking any medication. This over-the-counter medication reduces occasional insomnia and helps you fall asleep. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
